text.description_html:
DWD B170-32-630, 32" Heavy Duty Stainless Steel Bumper Guard

Packaged completed with one (1) 32" x 8" Bumper Guard, one (1) Back Plate, one (1) Mounting Plate plus two (2) 5/16-18 and four (4) 3/8-16 thru-bolts and nuts (bolt length for standard for 1-3/4" thick door).

The door Bumper Guard is a direct fit replacement for Bommer 170-32-630, and is heavy duty .109" thick stainless steel (ANSI K57434). The included back plate protects the face of the door from wear caused by sliding motion of the Bumper Guard.

Also available: Shorter 19 x 8 Stainless Steel Bumper Guard

Used to protect hospitals doors against gurneys (gurney door guards). Also used on commercial doors such as warehouses and factory doors that are run into with carts and forklifts. For use on wood and metal doors.

Can be install on one side of a single acting door or back to back on double acting doors (door swings in both directions). Note: Back to back installation requires Two (2) Bumpers.

Specifications for the DWD B170-32-630-32-630 Door Bumper Guard:

  • Material: .109" Stainless Steel (Heavy Duty)
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Bumper Guard Length: 32"
  • Bumper Guard Height: 8"
  • Bumper Guard Projection: 4-1/2"
  • Machine Screws with Nuts: (2) 5/16-18 and (4) 3/8-16
  • DWD-B170 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually.
